messages:
sam (partnerships): Marketplace engineering team pinged me — they opened a compliance intake for the cloud marketplace listing. They want a single zip with: SOC2 summary, recent external pen-test exec summary, SCA/SBOM statement, and answers to a 10-question security checklist. Timeline: submission in 3 business days. Can we assemble?

lee (security): We can. Quick Q: do they accept redacted pen-test summaries or do they require the raw report under NDA?

marta (legal): Usually they accept redacted exec summaries. If they ask for the raw report, vendor NDA + a data sharing addendum is required. I'll pre-check our pen-test vendor contract.

henry (eng): We have a dynamic application security testing (DAST) scan from Jan 2025 and a third-party pentest from Nov 2024 (scope: control plane, console). I can pull the exec-summary and the remediation tracker.

lee (security): Good. For the SBOM/SCA ask: we should include a short statement about our dependency scanning cadence, tool (Snyk), and top-level SBOM link. No full SBOM disclosure unless asked.

sam (partnerships): Copy of the marketplace checklist (they pasted in the intake):

```
1. SOC2: Do you have a SOC2 Type II report? (Y/N). If Y, provide an executive summary and scope period.
2. Penetration Test: Date, vendor, and high-level findings summary (redacted ok).
3. Vulnerability Management: Are there open critical vulnerabilities in production? (Y/N). If Y, provide mitigation timeline.
4. SBOM/SCA: Do you maintain an SBOM and use automated SCA tooling? Attach short statement.
5. Encryption: Describe encryption at-rest and in-transit, and KMS/HSM options.
6. Access Controls: Do you support RBAC, SSO (OIDC/SAML), and session timeouts?
7. Data Residency: Can you support region-specific hosting for marketplace customers?
8. Incident Response: Provide incident contact and last tabletop/exercise date.
9. Supply Chain: Any third-party hosted components requiring special review? List vendors.
10. Contact: Security POC for follow-ups and calendar availability for a 30min call.
```

sam (partnerships): They also asked for a point-of-contact; suggested window for call: next Tue/Wed mornings.

lee (security): I'll draft SOC2 exec summary (scope: infra + control plane, period: Jan-Dec 2024) and a 1-pager pen-test highlights. For vulnerabilities: we are clean of critical in prod; there were two high findings in dev that were patched and closed (ticket CH-2401). I'll say no open criticals.

henry (eng): I'll add the DAST summary and confirm the SCA statement text. For encryption: AES-256 envelope encryption for data-at-rest, TLS1.2+ for in-transit; for Private we support customer-managed KMS and HSM.

marta (legal): I'm ok with redacted pen-test execs. I'll also confirm we can share vendor name (Cobalt) per contract. If vendor disallows public sharing of the full report, we'll note that and offer a gated review under NDA.

devops-bot: Compliance packet workspace created: https://internal.redwood.com/compliance/packets/marketplace-1760456789 (access: partnerships, security, legal, eng).

sam (partnerships): Plan: lee to upload SOC2 + pen-test exec by tomorrow AM, henry to add encryption/SBOM/SCA text by EOD tomorrow, marta to confirm vendor sharing rules by EOD. I'll compile and send to marketplace.

lee (security): Will do. Draft note for the SBOM statement: "We maintain an SBOM generated from our CI pipeline, updated weekly. We use Snyk for SCA and run dependency checks on merge; critical/high findings are triaged within 72 hours." Thoughts?

henry (eng): That's accurate. Add: "We do not publish the full SBOM publicly but can provide a redacted SBOM or a gated review under NDA for marketplace review."

marta (legal): Perfect. Also add security contact: security@redwood.ai, and CC for legal review: legal@redwood.ai.

sam (partnerships): Thanks — if we can get the packet uploaded by tomorrow, we still have margin for their review. Otherwise we'll ask for a 48hr extension.

lee (security): Uploading SOC2 exec now to the packet link.

henry (eng): Pushed DAST summary + SCA statement to the packet.

marta (legal): Confirmed vendor allows exec-summary sharing. I'll add a note about NDA for raw reports.

sam (partnerships): Awesome. I'll draft the submission email and drop it in the packet for review before we send. If Marketplace requests the 30min call, please have availability Tue/Wed mornings. :phone:
